map.年折旧 = (C − S) / n。: Compute annual depreciation and the depreciation rate with the straight-line method from cost, salvage value and useful life.
map.年折旧 = (原值−残值)/年限: Annual Depreciation = (Cost − Salvage Value) / Useful Life
map.直线法各年折旧相同。: Straight-line depreciation is the same each year.
map.残值不计提折旧。: No depreciation is charged on the salvage value.
map.房屋、家具等效用在各期均衡的资产，用直线法平稳分摊成本。: For assets such as buildings and furniture whose usefulness is even across periods, the straight-line method spreads the cost evenly.
map.需要简单、可预期的年度折旧费用便于预算与报价。: When a simple, predictable annual depreciation expense is needed to ease budgeting and quoting.
map.税务折旧与会计折旧一致时，减少纳税调整工作量。: When tax and accounting depreciation match, it reduces tax adjustment work.
map.某设备原值 50 万元、预计残值 5 万元、使用年限 5 年，年折旧=(50−5: An asset has a cost of 50 (10k CNY), expected salvage value of 5 (10k CNY) and useful life of 5 years, so annual depreciation = (50−5)/5 = 9 (10k CNY) and monthly depreciation = 0.75 (10k CNY); after five years the net book value equals the salvage value of 5 (10k CNY).
map.直线法为什么最常用？: Why is the straight-line method the most common?
map.计算简单、各期费用均衡、利润平滑，适合效用稳定、技术更新慢的资产，也便于与外部报: It is simple to compute, keeps expenses even across periods and smooths profit, suits assets with stable usefulness and slow technological change, and aligns easily with external reporting and tax.
map.预计净残值为 0 或负数怎么办？: What if the expected net salvage value is zero or negative?
map.净残值一般取预计处置收入减处置费用后的净额，通常≥0；若预计处置费用高于收入，实: Net salvage value is generally the expected disposal proceeds minus disposal costs, usually 0 or more; if expected disposal costs exceed proceeds, practice still treats it as 0 and it may not be set negative.
map.直线折旧（年限平均法）：年折旧额 = (原值−残值)÷使用年限（元）；联动量：年: Straight-line depreciation (equal annual charge): annual depreciation = (original value − residual value) ÷ useful life (CNY); linked values: annual depreciation rate = annual depreciation ÷ original value × 100 (%), book value at the end of the first year = original value − annual depreciation (CNY). Validation: the three inputs are required and prompt when empty; when useful life is 0 the division-by-zero result falls back to —. Rule: no fixed grading; each year's depreciation is equal and the book value declines linearly to the residual value.
